pages.title: Your turn
pages.body: Move one of your glyphlings any distance along a leyline — it can’t pass through anything. Then cast a seed from where it landed, along any leyline, onto an empty hex.

pages.title: Words make Magic
pages.body: Every word the new seed makes, on every leyline, grows Magic: one per letter, plus one for each of your own seeds in it. Made Magic? Draw a seed. Made none? You may refresh your seeds.

pages.title: A tangled garden
pages.body: A glyphling with nowhere to move is tangled. When two are tangled the game ends: each rival piece next to a tangled glyphling earns its owner +3. Magic stays secret until the end — most Magic becomes Grand Glyphtender!
